data.title: Arknights: Endfield [Meeting You in the World o'Shrooms] Version DEV Comm
data.brief:
Dear Endministrator, 
This is the Arknights: Endfield Team. 
As shadow fades, all things emerge anew
data.data:
Dear Endministrator, 
This is the Arknights: Endfield Team. 
As shadow fades, all things emerge anew. Arknights: Endfield new version [Meeting You in the World o'Shrooms] will officially launch on Nov. 25, 2026. Through this DEV Comm, we would like to share the major optimizations and adjustments that will be made in this version.


[New Version Guide] Page Now Updated

To make it easier to see what's new, the [New Version Guide] page has been updated with information on the main content and other details about the [Meeting You in the World o'Shrooms] version. Visit the page and hit [Claim Rewards] to receive the following version preview rewards in-game before the next version update: [Oroberyl]×1000, [T-Creds]×10000, [Elementary Cognitive Carrier]×8, and [Arms INSP Set]×4.

The link to the page has been sent via in-game mail. You can also find it in in-game notices and on our social media channels.

Go & View: https://endfield.gryphline.com/version_briefing/latest?source_from=official

New [Smart Picks] Feature in [Game Tools]

A new [Smart Picks] feature will be added to the [Team Picks] and [Build Guide] tools. Based on the operators you own, it recommends teams suited to specific stages, along with relevant team building suggestions.

You can access this feature in-game via [Protosync] > [Game Tools], or visit the official SKPORT community and navigate to [tools section - Team Picks].

AIC Factory Gameplay Improvements

· Improved the Placement of Control Ports: Improved the placement of Item Control Ports and Pipe Control Ports. They can now be placed without first being connected to a transport belt or pipe. They can connect directly to the belt or pipe ports of a facility and will automatically snap into place in the correct orientation.

Progression Experience Improvements

· Added [Wuling Multi-Line Engraving Kit]: Purchase [Wuling Multi-Line Engraving Kit]×1 with [Wuling Stock Bills] after upgrading [Wuling - Yinglung Pass] Stock Redistribution Terminal to level 4.

· Improved the Display of Progression Materials: Improved upgrade prompts on the [Operators - Ability Matrix] screen. When an upgrade requires many types of materials, materials in insufficient quantities are automatically repositioned and displayed first, making it easier to review.

· Improved Gear Artificing: Added the new item [Origo-Artificing Fluid Mk Ⅰ] that guarantees success when performing a gear artificing attempt on gold quality Wuling gear. This item can be obtained in the [Array Building: Mend the Old Gash] Building Event.


[Delver of the Cryptic] Special Edition Available

· Added the new spatial set [Esoteric Mycology]: [Delver of the Cryptic] will introduce the new spatial set [Esoteric Mycology], which comprises 3 Protocol Spaces. Complete the spatial set puzzle challenges to claim [Oroberyls] and other rewards.

This will be the final update for [Delver of the Cryptic] as a permanent game mode. Updates to this mode will pause afterward, but it will return in other forms in the future.

In-development optimizations

Here is an early preview of some planned content.

· New Permanent Activity [Main Mission Early Unlock: Gypsosia]: After the next version update, the new permanent activity [Main Mission Early Unlock: Gypsosia] will be added to the game and accessible via the [Events] screen.

After completing the main mission [Chapter Ⅰ Process Ⅰ: Break the Siege], you can use the [Events] screen to unlock the [The Cretaceous Frontiers (Gypsosia)] region and its main missions early. The content of New Horizons Tribute and Beginner's Chartered Tribute will also be adjusted accordingly. You can earn their rewards by completing the specified main missions.

Main missions of different chapters can coexist. You can return to [Valley IV] or [Wuling] whenever you wish to pick up their stories. You won't miss out on any content from previous chapters.

· Improved Team System: The maximum number of teams will be increased to 15, so you can preset more teams for various combat situations. A [Team Details] button will also be added to this screen. Click it to view all your teams, then choose a team and click [Deploy] to deploy it.

Thank you for your continued interest and support for Arknights: Endfield, Endministrator. In addition to the content introduced in this DEV Comm, additional gameplay features and optimizations are in development and will be introduced in future versions. We look forward to sharing more with you the next time we meet.


We're nearing the end of 2026, and this year's final version update is just around the corner. Our journey in Wuling is about to wrap up, too. Until then, let's traverse the "World o'Shrooms" and meet again at year-end. Our exploration of Talos-II will never cease. New stories and uncharted lands lie ahead, waiting for us to discover them together.

Arknights: Endfield Team
